title: marrubium × bastetanum var. negretense
intro: Marrubium × bastetanum var. negretense, commonly known as Bastetanum, is a variety of the Marrubium plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bastetanum include analgesic, anti-hemorrhagic, and expectorant effects, making it useful in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Bastetanum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
